environment.description: Flask application deployed in a gVisor (runsc) sandboxed container with a custom OCI runtime seccomp profile applied at the container runtime level. The profile operates in whitelist mode with the following permitted syscall set: read, write, close, fstat, lseek, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, mremap, msync, madvise, shmget, shmat, shmctl, dup, dup2, pause, nanosleep, getitimer, alarm, setitimer, getpid, sendfile, accept, bind, listen, getsockname, getpeername, clone, fork, vfork, openat, mkdirat, newfstatat, unlinkat, readlinkat, fchmodat, faccessat, futex, epoll_create1, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, getrandom, getcwd, chdir, rename, mkdir, rmdir, creat, unlink, readlink, chmod, fchmod, chown, fchown, lchown, umask, gettimeofday, getrlimit, getrusage, sysinfo, times, getuid, getgid, geteuid, getegid, getppid, getpgrp, setsid, setreuid, setregid, getgroups, setgroups, setresuid, setresgid, getresuid, getresgid, sigaltstack, statfs, fstatfs, arch_prctl, set_tid_address, set_robust_list, exit_group, exit, tgkill, clock_gettime, clock_getres, clock_nanosleep, prlimit64, fcntl, poll, lstat, stat, getdents64, getdents, pipe2, eventfd2, timerfd_create, timerfd_settime, signalfd4, accept4, dup3, epoll_create, inotify_init1, pread64, pwrite64, writev, readv, recvfrom, sendto, recvmsg, sendmsg, shutdown, setsockopt, getsockopt. Note: socket syscall is NOT in the whitelist. The container filesystem is mounted read-only except for /tmp/uploads (tmpfs, noexec, size=50M) and /var/app/extracted (tmpfs, noexec, nosuid, size=100M). The extracted tmpfs at /var/app/extracted has the noexec flag preventing execution of written files. Path traversal writes outside these tmpfs mounts will fail with EROFS since the root filesystem is read-only.
